mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.enabled = 1 AND m.enabled = 1 AND m.visible = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
SELECT * FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort_no, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu ( parent_id, menu_name, path, route_name, component, icon, menu_type, permission_code, sort_no, visible, enabled, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{path}, #{routeName}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{menuType}, #{permissionCode}, #{sortNo}, #{visible}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, path = #{path}, route_name = #{routeName}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, menu_type = #{menuType}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, visible = #{visible}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
